description: A Scaffold Design Engineer is responsible for creating safe and efficient scaffold designs using industry standards and codes utilizes scaffold structural design software and computer-aided design (CAD) and systems to develop accurate scaffold drawings. The design engineer calculatesloads in accordance with national and international standards and analyzes scaffold structures using design software like STAAD Pro software and have good understanding of scaffold specifications, drawings, Indian and international standard codes to ensure compliance and safety in scaffold designs.
typeOfQualification: Cross Sectoral (CS), Upskilling, Future Skills, Fresh Skilling
